name: Clarisse
source:
A chatterbox who loves talking as much as she loves befriending people. Generally bright and happy until in contact with Hora. She possesses mild malice towards him for reasons which Hora would have to find out... or possibly die.

[spoiler] She is the current host of Kaisha, the Spirit of Justice.[/spoiler]
